1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is not ethyl__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __and R2 is not ethyl__.

3. (Original) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is methyl or ethyl.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein Z is not potassium__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II b) in which Z is sodium or potassium, __and Z is not potassium__.
